comparison.objective: Free a hand trapped by a stopped, braked robot arm; candidate safely tunes an isolated robot-axis damper.
comparison.physical_skill: Emergency load relief or controlled arm release versus precise key insertion, bimanual counterhold, adjuster rotation, and lock tightening.
comparison.success_condition: Release method, force limits, and injury criteria are unavailable; candidate requires no energized adjustment and two safe, repeatable carriage stops.
comparison.reason: Shared robot context and safety concerns do not equate emergency extrication with damper commissioning.
